newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares end a shade higher in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares end a shade higher in listless trade.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Swiss shares ended a listless and rangebound session slightly higher after posting moderate gains on the back of Wall Street's strength on Friday before shifting into a sideways trading pattern.

"The fundamentals continue to look good, but I think the SMI will hover around 3,800 points until the end of the week", one dealer said, noting that Friday's expiry on options and futures may lead to some price volatility in blue-chip shares.
* Blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) up 8.5 points, or 0.22 percent, to 3,813.7 and the all-share Swiss Performance Index (SPI) added 5.24 points, or 0.22 percent, to 2,440.88.
